contract: A field decision clears only its own gFieldStatuses bit, and only when pinned source plus authoritative request operands prove that bit cannot change the displayed single-hit damage range for this exact request. Each active bit is assessed independently; RELEVANT and UNKNOWN never clear. A bit outside the reviewed pinned mask is always UNKNOWN. Clearing a field bit never clears an ability, item, move-mechanic, weather, side-status, volatile, gimmick or challenge limitation, and those never clear a field bit.

operands.ordinary_move: The selected move is ORDINARY_PROVEN_EQUIVALENT in HnsMoveMechanicsRegistry (single-hit EFFECT_HIT, no terrain boost - checked by this generator).
operands.pre_field_move_type: The pinned move type (Fairy toggle applied), accepted only with an observed GIMMICK_NONE attacker and a known effective attacker ability that GetDynamicMoveType does not read.
operands.effective_move_type: pre_field_move_type, additionally requiring the attacker's Electrify volatile observed false, the field word decoded with no unknown bit, and Ion Deluge not rewriting a Normal move.
operands.move_id: The pinned move ID; Gravity-banned and positive-priority facts are generated from the pinned move table.
operands.attacker_ability: The boundary-owned effective attacker ability ID from the live battler.
operands.defender_ability: The boundary-owned effective defender ability ID from the live battler.
operands.attacker_item: The boundary-owned live battle-effective attacker item ID (in domain).
operands.defender_item: The boundary-owned live battle-effective defender item ID (in domain).

unknown_bits.predicate: Any observed bit outside the twelve reviewed pinned bits. The pinned build never sets one, so it means an unexpected or torn read; it is preserved and always blocks.

starting_conditions.trainer_starting_statuses: TryFieldEffects(FIELD_EFFECT_TRAINER_STATUSES) applies gStartingStatuses (terrains, Trick/Magic/Wonder Room) before the first turn; gStartingStatuses is filled only from the trainer table's startingStatus, and no pinned H&S trainer (src/data/trainers_hns.h / trainers_hns.party) declares one.
starting_conditions.overworld_terrain: FIELD_EFFECT_OVERWORLD_TERRAIN needs B_THUNDERSTORM_TERRAIN (FALSE in include/config/battle.h) or B_OVERWORLD_FOG >= GEN_8 (GEN_3), so overworld weather never sets terrain in H&S 2.0.5.
starting_conditions.switch_in_abilities: Electric Surge and Hadron Engine (Electric Terrain), Grassy Surge, Misty Surge and Psychic Surge set terrain on switch-in before either side selects a move (AbilityBattleEffects -> TryChangeBattleTerrain). With Random Abilities either lead can carry one, so a fresh battle can already show a terrain bit.
starting_conditions.after_first_move: Rooms, Gravity, Mud/Water Sport, Fairy Lock, Ion Deluge, Seed Sower and terrain moves set bits only once a move or its effect runs.

statuses.rationale: Magic Room makes GetBattlerHoldEffect return HOLD_EFFECT_NONE for every battler, so it can switch off any held item's hold effect (damage, grounding, speed); its other reads are Natural Gift/Fling failure and Unburden, none reachable by an ordinary move. No H&S item is modelled by the engine, so when every held item is ITEM_NONE or has a globally audited neutral hold effect, suppressing those hold effects cannot change this hit.

rules.predicate: Ordinary move, and both authoritative live battle-effective items are ITEM_NONE or globally PROVEN_NO_ORDINARY_DAMAGE_EFFECT.

statuses.fallback: Any held item without a neutral global audit, an unread item, or a non-ordinary move keeps Magic Room blocking: its suppression of a damage-relevant hold effect is not modelled.

statuses.rationale: Trick Room only reverses the speed comparison (and triggers Room Service / Magician ordering). Turn order reaches an ordinary move's damage only through the attacker's Analytic (IsLastMonToMove); the turn-order base-power effects (Payback, Bolt Beak, Gyro Ball, ...) are never ordinary.

rules.predicate: Ordinary move and the authoritative effective attacker ability is not Analytic.
The attacker's effective ability is Analytic, whose x1.3 depends on turn order.

statuses.fallback: Unknown attacker ability or non-ordinary move never clears.
